steps.text: Download the official Fetch Rewards app from the Apple App Store or Google Play Store (free).
Open the app and create an account with your email (or Google/Facebook login); provide your name and a valid mobile phone number.

Check the Special Offers tab for bonus-point offers on specific brands before you shop.
Once your balance reaches at least 3,000 points, open the Rewards tab, pick a gift card (e.g. $3 Amazon), tap Get My Reward, and find the gift card under My Rewards / your email.

routes.what: Search ISBN, compare buyback prices, ship textbook, receive payment
routes.reward: Comparison tool for textbook buyback prices (varies per book; BookFinder is not itself a buyer — no fixed $200)
routes.requirements: Active student status, .edu email or student ID, may need verification through SheerID
routes.payout_timing: BookFinder pays nothing itself; timing depends on the buyback vendor you select from the comparison.
catches: BookFinder never buys your book — it only compares other vendors' buyback offers; you complete the sale with a third party.
Buyback value varies per book, edition, condition, and vendor — the $200 headline is unsupported and unrealistic for most books.
Older editions and low-demand titles may get no offers at all.

steps.text: Go to https://www.bookfinder.com/ and use the 'Textbook Buyback' option in the For Students section.
Search by ISBN to get the exact edition of your textbook.
Compare the buyback offers from the listed vendors, including shipping costs.
Pick the best offer and click through to that vendor's site.
Follow the vendor's own sell process (enter condition, accept quote, ship with their label).
Track the vendor's payment timing — BookFinder has no role after you leave its site.

routes.what: Enter ISBN, get quote, ship free, receive payment
routes.reward: Chegg no longer buys books (since mid-2022) — selling routes through Valore's marketplace (functional duplicate of R0368)
routes.requirements: Active student status, .edu email or student ID, may need verification through SheerID
routes.payout_timing: Chegg pays nothing itself; sales complete on Valore's marketplace — Valore issues payment within 14 business days of warehouse processing (check via USPS 7-14 days, PayPal 2-14 days).
catches: Chegg does not buy your book — since 2022 all textbook selling is routed to Valore's marketplace, making this route functionally identical to Valore sellback.
Payout varies per book and condition — the $200 headline is unsupported.
Payment comes from Valore (check or PayPal), not Chegg, and can take weeks.

steps.text: Start your search at https://www.chegg.com/books for the textbook you want to sell.
Chegg redirects book listings and purchases to Valore's marketplace product pages.
On the Valore page, get your sellback quote for the book (amount varies by title and condition).
Accept the quote, use the prepaid shipping label, and ship within 7 days of the quote.
Valore's warehouse receives and evaluates the book; payment is issued within 14 business days.
Receive payment by check (USPS, 7-14 business days) or PayPal (2-14 business days).

routes.what: Enter ISBN, get quote, ship free, receive payment

routes.requirements: Active student status, .edu email or student ID, may need verification through SheerID
routes.payout_timing: Payment issued within 14 business days of warehouse processing; check arrives 7-14 business days via USPS, PayPal posts 2-14 business days.
catches: Payout varies per book, edition, condition, and demand — the $200 headline is unsupported; many books quote far less.
Books must be shipped within 7 days of the quote; prepaid labels expire after 10 days.
If the book's condition doesn't match your description, the quote can be revised down.
Full cycle (quote, ship, warehouse evaluation, payment) takes weeks.

steps.text: Go to https://www.valore.com/sellback and enter your textbook's ISBN to get a sellback quote.
Accept the quote if the price works for you (quotes vary per book and condition).
Use Valore's prepaid shipping label and ship the book within 7 days of receiving the quote.
Valore's warehouse receives and evaluates the book against your stated condition.
Payment is issued within 14 business days of warehouse processing.
Receive payment by check (USPS, 7-14 business days) or PayPal (2-14 business days).

routes.requirements: Varies by app: 13+ or 18+, US resident, email account, honest demographic profile, PayPal for most payouts
routes.payout_timing: Points can remain pending up to one month under provider review; redemption processing time not stated officially (third-party sources report PayPal payouts are typically instant at cashout).
catches: Rewards are per survey with screenouts — survey availability is not guaranteed, invitations depend on your profile and research demand, and the effective hourly rate is low.
Per the official help article, some survey answers go through a provider review process and 'points remain in pending status until the end of the review which may take up to one month.'
You must complete surveys or other rewardable actions to earn points; points do not expire for active members but are forfeited if you deactivate.
Identity verification may be required before redeeming (third-party sources report photo ID + selfie for PayPal transfers).
E-gift cards and bank transfers are available to US members only (third-party); redemption options vary by location and verification status per the official article.
Survey Junkie's own FAQ (quoted by third-party sources): 'You will not get rich by taking surveys.'

steps.text: Sign up for free at surveyjunkie.com with your email (or Google/Facebook) and complete the initial demographic profile — you earn points for profile completion.
Check your survey feed; each survey shows its point value and estimated time before you start.
Take surveys honestly and consistently — some answers go through provider review, and points can stay pending for up to one month.
Once you reach 500 points ($5), redeem via PayPal, bank transfer, or e-gift cards (gift cards and bank transfer are US-only per third-party sources); complete identity verification if requested.
Stay active (complete a survey at least every 12 months) so points don't lapse; deactivating forfeits unredeemed points.

You file the actual claim with the state treasury/controller holding the funds, not with MissingMoney — the state requires ID and proof of address.
No payout timeline is published; state processing commonly takes weeks to months.

steps.text: Go to https://missingmoney.com/ in your browser.
Type your last name (or business name) and first name into the search boxes and tap Search.
Repeat the search for every state you have lived or worked in; also try previous names and common misspellings (the site explicitly recommends this).
Open any match and check the details (old address, holder name) to confirm the property is really yours.
Tap through to initiate the claim — the site redirects you to the official state treasury/controller website holding the funds.
Submit the state's claim form with your photo ID and proof of address directly to the state.
Wait for the state to verify and pay you; check back often since new properties are added daily.

routes.what: Select your state, search, file claim
routes.reward: NAUPA on unclaimed.org: 'Yes! It is free to search for and claim your missing money! There is no fee to search for and claim your unclaimed property — if you use your official state program.' This finds money ALREADY OWED TO YOU (a forgotten account, uncashed check, security deposit) if it exists in a state database — it never promises anyone has any.
routes.requirements: 18+ (or guardian for minors), US resident, government ID, proof of address, patience for processing timelines
routes.payout_timing: Search is instant. Claim processing is handled by each state's official program — typically weeks to a few months after you submit proof of identity and ownership.
catches: Most searches return nothing — NAUPA says 1 in 10 people have unclaimed property, which means 9 in 10 do not.
Third-party 'finder' firms may legally take a percentage of your money; the official state program is always free — use it directly.
You must prove ownership with documents (SSN, old addresses, pay stubs, utility bills); a name match alone pays nothing.
Impostor sites mimic state programs — always reach the state site from unclaimed.org's map or MissingMoney.com.
Claims are verified by the state before payout, so even a confirmed match takes weeks to months.

steps.text: Go to https://unclaimed.org/search/ and use the interactive map to pick your state, or use MissingMoney.com (the free multi-state search sponsored by NAUPA) to check participating states at once.
Search EVERY state you have lived or done business in — property is reported to the state where the company resides, so matches commonly span multiple states.
If your name matches, click through to that state's official unclaimed-property program website (never a third-party finder).
File the claim on the state site and upload proof of identity and ownership (pay stub, utility bill, SSN, old address records).
Track the claim on the state site; expect weeks to a few months for verification and payout.

routes.requirements: 18+ (or guardian for minors), US resident, government ID, proof of address, patience for processing timelines
routes.payout_timing: Search is instant. If matched, you contact PBGC (found@pbgc.gov / 800-400-7242) and provide employment details; benefit verification and payout timing are per-case.

You may not even know you are owed a benefit (e.g., a short stint at an old employer decades ago).

steps.text: Go to https://www.pbgc.gov/search/unclaimed-pensions and search by your last name, former employer name, or the state where the company was headquartered.
If your name appears, email found@pbgc.gov (or missing@pbgc.gov) with your current mailing address and dates of employment, or call PBGC's customer contact center at 800-400-7242.
Provide the employment details and identity documents PBGC requests to verify you are the missing participant.
If verified, PBGC pays the benefit it is holding for you.

Funds escheat to the state after ~18 months; the FDIC tool only covers the window before transfer.
Claimants must prove identity and ownership; heirs/executors need estate documentation.
Beware of anyone demanding money up front to 'help' — the FDIC says you do not need paid help to search or claim.

steps.text: Go to https://closedbanks.fdic.gov/funds/ and search by your first and/or last name (or business name); narrow by failed bank name, city, or state if you know them.
If you find a match, use the claim form on the page and follow the FDIC's instructions to file.
If the bank failed long ago (roughly 18+ months), check the state unclaimed-property program of your last known address instead — federal law moves those funds to the state.
Provide the identity/ownership proof the FDIC or state requests to complete the claim.

routes.what: Use IRS Where's My Refund tool, update address
routes.reward: IRS: 'If you e-filed your return, after 24 hours, you can go to irs.gov/refund to check on its status using our Where's My Refund? tool.' This finds YOUR OWN tax refund money — overpaid tax the government owes back to you — if it is delayed, lost, or undelivered; it never promises anyone is owed any.
routes.requirements: 18+ (or guardian for minors), US resident, government ID, proof of address, patience for processing timelines
routes.payout_timing: Refund status generally available within 24 hours of e-file acknowledgment (4 weeks for paper). Typical payout: about 21 days for e-filed direct-deposit refunds. Lost/stolen check trace via Form 3911: the Bureau of the Fiscal Service review can take up to six weeks.
catches: Only works for refunds on returns you actually filed — no return, no refund to find.
Do not rely on a specific date; some returns need additional review and take longer.
EITC/Additional Child Tax Credit refunds are held by law until mid-February.
Paper tax refund checks are being phased out (since Sept 30, 2025) — direct deposit is the default path.
The IRS will never call/text/email demanding payment or personal info about your refund — those are scams.

steps.text: Go to https://www.irs.gov/refund and use Where's My Refund? with your SSN, filing status, and exact refund amount (or the IRS2Go mobile app).
If it shows the refund was sent but you never got it: if you moved, file Form 8822 to update your address with the IRS.

If the check is lost or was never delivered, initiate a refund trace — in Where's My Refund, via the automated line 800-829-1954, or by filing Form 3911 (Taxpayer Statement Regarding Refund); married-filing-jointly filers must use the form or call 800-829-1040.

If the check was cashed by someone else, the Bureau of the Fiscal Service sends a claim package (up to six weeks for review); if it was never cashed, a replacement is issued once the original is canceled.

Choose your payment method if offered (check, PayPal, Venmo, prepaid card).
Save your confirmation number and wait — payments typically arrive months after the final approval hearing.

routes.method: Search for state attorney general restitution programs
routes.what: Search your state AG website, file claim if eligible
routes.reward: NY Attorney General complaint form: 'The Attorney General is not my private attorney, but represents the public in enforcing laws designed to protect the public from misleading or unlawful business practices.' Restitution reaches consumers through AG enforcement — e.g., the September 2026 $694M multistate settlement with Credit Acceptance Corporation, where 'consumers eligible for restitution will be notified by a claims administrator.' This recovers YOUR OWN money taken by a business — it never promises any payout.
routes.requirements: 18+ (or guardian for minors), US resident, government ID, proof of address, patience for processing timelines
routes.payout_timing: Complaint filing is immediate (online in most states). Mediation outcomes and multistate-settlement payouts are slow — settlements take years, and eligible consumers are notified by a claims administrator after the deal closes.
catches: The AG is not your private attorney and filing creates no obligation for the office to act on your case.
No legal advice and no court representation — for that you need a private attorney or small-claims court.
Restitution is uncertain and slow; most value comes from rare multistate settlements, not individual complaints.
Your complaint (and documents) may be shared with the business you complained about and with other agencies.
False statements on a complaint form can be a criminal misdemeanor.

steps.text: Find your state AG's consumer-complaint page — NAUPA-style hub https://naag.org links every state; e.g., Indiana files at in.gov/attorneygeneral/consumer-protection-division/file-a-complaint/ or by mail/fax.
First attempt to resolve the issue directly with the business (most AG offices require this).

File the complaint online (or by printable form) with copies — never originals — of contracts, receipts, and correspondence; note the resolution you want (refund, product delivery, service performed).
The AG's office may forward your complaint to the business for mediation, or use it as evidence in an enforcement action.

Watch for multistate settlements in your state: if one covers you, the claims administrator notifies you directly and you file with them — e.g., the Sept 2026 $694M Credit Acceptance settlement across 40+ states.

routes.what: Search SEC claims database, file if eligible
routes.reward: SEC Fair Fund order (Release No. 105805, June 29, 2026 – Chatham Asset Management): 'The Plan provides for the distribution of the Fair Fund, plus accumulated interest, less taxes, fees, and expenses, to the harmed investors according to the methodology set forth in the Plan.' This returns YOUR OWN lost investment money if you were a harmed investor in that case — it never promises anyone qualifies.
routes.requirements: 18+ (or guardian for minors), US resident, government ID, proof of address, patience for processing timelines
routes.payout_timing: Per-case and slow: a Notice of Proposed Plan of Distribution publishes, comments run ~30 days, the plan is approved, then a claims bar date is set. Distributions often come years after the enforcement action (e.g., 2026 disbursement orders for cases noticed in 2023–2025).
catches: No central searchable claims database — you must match yourself to individual enforcement cases.
Each case has a hard claims bar date; late claims are out.
Eligibility is narrow (specific securities, specific dates) — most investors qualify for nothing.
Distributions take years and are reduced by taxes, fees, and expenses.
Beware of third parties charging to 'recover' SEC funds — claims are filed free with the fund administrator.

steps.text: Watch SEC Division of Enforcement releases for cases involving securities you actually traded (e.g., 2026 Fair Fund orders for Chatham Asset Management, Boeing, Barclays).
When a Notice of Proposed Plan of Distribution is published for a case you may fit, get the plan from sec.gov (or by written request to the named SEC contact).
Read the plan's eligibility (relevant period, recognized loss methodology) — if you do not fit, stop.
File your claim with the appointed Fund Administrator before the plan's claims bar date, with trade documentation; denied claims get a chance to cure.
Wait for the disbursement order — payment comes only after claims are processed.

routes.method: Search for product recalls and refunds
routes.what: Search recalls, file for refund or replacement
routes.reward: Recalls.gov: six federal agencies 'have joined together to create Recalls.gov — a "one stop shop" for U.S. Government recalls.' Recalls find SAFETY REMEDIES for products you already own (refund, repair, or replacement per the recall notice) — this is not income and pays nothing if you do not own a recalled product.
routes.requirements: 18+ (or guardian for minors), US resident, government ID, proof of address, patience for processing timelines
routes.payout_timing: Search is instant. Remedies follow each recall notice's instructions — often a return to the store where purchased or direct contact with the manufacturer; you usually do not need a receipt.
catches: Not income — remedies are refund/repair/replacement of products you already own.
You must match the exact recalled product identifiers; a similar-looking product may not be covered.
Recall remedies differ per notice — read it carefully (some medical-device recalls mean check/adjust, not return).
Safety recalls do not expire, so check secondhand and hand-me-down items too.

steps.text: Go to https://www.recalls.gov/ and use Recent Recalls or Search for Recalls (by agency/product type) to check products you own — especially children's products, appliances, and secondhand purchases.
Match your product exactly against the recall notice: brand, model number, batch/lot codes, and date range.
Follow the recall notice's remedy instructions: return to the store, contact the manufacturer, or stop using the product as directed.
Sign up for recall email alerts from the relevant agencies so future recalls reach you.

routes.method: Search for consumer product safety recalls

routes.reward: CPSC (Sept 2026 recall announcements, e.g.): 'JKMAX Recalls Heated Blankets and Heating Pads Due to Fire and Burn Hazards — Units: 195,000.' Each CPSC recall notice names the product, hazard, units affected, and the remedy. Recalls find SAFETY REMEDIES for products you already own — this is not income and pays nothing if you do not own a recalled product.
routes.requirements: 18+ (or guardian for minors), US resident, government ID, proof of address, patience for processing timelines
routes.payout_timing: Search is instant; CPSC posts new recalls and safety warnings regularly (weekly announcement batches, e.g., Sept 2026). Remedy timing follows each recall notice.
catches: Not income — remedies are refund/repair/replacement of owned products.
Must match exact product identifiers; near-matches do not qualify.
Overlaps with R0308 (recalls.gov aggregates CPSC recalls) — consider this the deeper CPSC-specific path.
Report dangerous products via SaferProducts.gov or the CPSC hotline (800-638-2772); reporting is separate from claiming a remedy.

steps.text: Go to https://www.cpsc.gov/ and use the Recalls search to check products you own (search by product name, brand, or model).
Match your product exactly against the recall notice — brand, model number, batch, and where/when sold (e.g., 'Sold Exclusively at Target').
Follow the notice's remedy: contact the firm, return the product, or stop using it as directed.
Subscribe to CPSC recall email alerts so new recalls reach you automatically.

routes.what: Open account via referral/promo link, verify identity, link bank, complete qualifying actions
routes.reward: $1,000 statement credit (business-only; apply 9/1-9/30/2026; $4,000 qualifying spend in 30 days)
routes.requirements: 18+, US resident, valid SSN, new customer, referral link may be required, qualifying direct deposit or transaction
routes.payout_timing: The Offer Bonus will typically be applied by your February 2027 statement.
catches: BUSINESS ONLY: the official terms define 'You' and 'your' as 'the business participating in or seeking to participate in this Offer' — individual consumers are not eligible.
The route's $200 claim is stale/wrong: the current official September 2026 activation offer pays a $1,000 USD statement credit, not $200.
You must apply between September 1 and September 30, 2026, be approved, activate with your first purchase, then spend at least $4,000 in Qualifying Spend within the first 30 days after activation.

Qualifying Spend excludes cash withdrawals, commercial utilities, money transfers, prepaid cards and cash equivalents, fees and fines, fraudulent/disputed/chargeback transactions — and Brex may exclude transaction types at any time.
The bonus is only awarded upon payment in full of amounts owed; the account must remain in good standing through the earning and award periods.
Brex reserves the right to cancel or modify the terms or terminate eligibility at any time without prior notice, and may withhold, claw back, or reverse the bonus.
Tax consequences are yours: Brex may request a W-9 and issue tax forms.
Offer cannot be combined with any other promotional bonus offer; qualifying for a Brex account is not guaranteed.

steps.text: Confirm you are applying as a business — the offer defines 'you' as the business; individual consumers are not eligible.
Between September 1 and September 30, 2026, apply for a new Brex account and Brex Card and get approved (approval is not guaranteed).
Activate the account with your first purchase on the Brex Card — activation starts the 30-day Earning Period.

Spend at least $4,000 in Qualifying Spend on the Brex Card within those 30 days (net cleared USD; excludes cash withdrawals, utilities, money transfers, prepaid cards, fees/fines, disputed transactions).
Pay the statement balance in full — the bonus is only awarded upon payment in full of amounts owed — and keep the account in good standing.
The $1,000 statement credit is typically applied by your February 2027 statement; expect tax documentation (e.g., W-9/1099) requirements.

routes.method: Open SoFi Savings, deposit new money for bonus
routes.what: Open SoFi Savings, deposit qualifying amount within set window
routes.reward: SoFi (official 'Up to $400 Bonus Tiered Disclosure'): 'New and existing Checking and Savings members who have not previously enrolled in Direct Deposit with SoFi are eligible to earn a cash bonus of either $50 (with at least $1,000 total Eligible Direct Deposits received within 25 calendar days of your first Eligible Direct Deposit of $1 or more) OR $400 (with at least $5,000 total Eligible Direct Deposits received within 25 calendar days of your first Eligible Direct Deposit of $1 or more).' Bonus paid within ~7 business days of meeting requirements.
routes.requirements: Varies by app: 18+, US resident, smartphone or computer, email account
routes.payout_timing: Cash bonus paid within ~7 business days after completing the direct-deposit requirements (25-day window from first eligible deposit). APY boost lasts up to 6 months.
catches: Bonus tiers are strict: $1,000-$4,999.99 in eligible direct deposits within 25 calendar days of your first eligible direct deposit earns $50; $5,000+ earns $400; under $1,000 earns $0.
Only members who have never enrolled in direct deposit with SoFi are eligible — prior direct-deposit users are excluded.
'Eligible Direct Deposit' means recurring ACH from an employer/benefits provider/government agency; bank-to-bank transfers, P2P payments, and one-off ACH sends generally do not count.
Bonus is paid within about 7 business days after meeting requirements — not instantly at signup.

The +0.90% APY boost (up to 4.00% total) applies to ONE SoFi Savings account for up to 6 months only; base savings APY is 3.10% (rate current as of 5/28/2026) and all rates are variable and subject to change.
Promotion periods are limited: direct-deposit bonus runs 5/15/2026 through 12/31/2026; APY boost requires opening 9/3/2026-12/31/2026 — SoFi can change or end either without notice.

SoFi Checking and Savings is a combo account (no standalone savings); no monthly account fees, but outgoing wires/instant transfers carry transaction fees. FDIC via SoFi Bank, N.A. (up to $3M with opt-in to the Insured Deposit Program).

steps.text: Open your first SoFi Checking and Savings account at sofi.com during the promotion period (bonus promo through 12/31/2026; APY boost requires opening 9/3/2026-12/31/2026).
Set up direct deposit from your employer (or benefits/government payer) into the SoFi account — bank-to-bank or P2P transfers do not count as eligible.
Receive at least $5,000 in total eligible direct deposits within 25 calendar days of your first eligible direct deposit to earn the full $400 (or $1,000-$4,999.99 for $50).
Keep the account open and in good standing; the bonus is deposited within about 7 business days after you meet the requirements.
Separately, the 0.90% APY boost (up to 4.00% total on one savings account) runs for up to 6 months — after that you earn the variable base rate (~3.10% as of 5/28/2026, subject to change).
No monthly fees apply, so the bonus is net of account costs; watch for transaction fees only if you wire money out.

The APY is variable and can change before or after you open the account — Discover's own disclosure states the advertised APY is only 'accurate as of' a stated date.
Interest is not a bonus: on a $1,000 balance at 3.30% APY you earn roughly $33 in a year — real money, but slow and proportional to your balance.

Discover Bank is now part of Capital One (acquisition closed 2025); deposit-agreement terms have been updated accordingly — confirm current terms before opening.
Online-only account: no branches; customer service is 24/7 by phone/app.

steps.text: Go to discover.com and open a Discover Online Savings Account online or by phone (no minimum deposit to open, $0 monthly fee).
Fund the account via ACH transfer from your existing bank (allow 1-3 business days for the transfer to post).
Your balance earns the current variable APY (recently ~3.30%), compounded daily and credited monthly — read the live rate on discover.com at signup since it changes.
There is no bonus to chase right now: do not expect a fixed signup payout; your earnings are purely the interest on your balance.
Keep balances within FDIC limits ($250,000 per depositor, per ownership category at Discover Bank) if your balance is large.
Re-check discover.com periodically — if Discover relaunches a fixed savings bonus, it becomes a separate, concrete payout worth acting on.

routes.method: Open savings through Raisin marketplace for bonus
routes.what: Open account through Raisin, deposit at partner bank, earn bonus
routes.reward: Raisin (official): 'Eligible new customers may earn a cash bonus (the "Welcome Bonus") when they deposit and maintain funds with partner banks on the Raisin platform. Customers will receive a Welcome Bonus of $40 for depositing between $10,000 and $24,999; $100 for depositing between $25,000 and $49,999; $200 for depositing between $50,000 and $99,999; $425 for depositing between $100,000 and $199,999; and $900 for depositing $200,000 or more.' An additional savings+CD boost ($10-$100 by tier) brings the maximum to $1,000.
routes.requirements: Varies by app: 18+, US resident, smartphone or computer, email account
routes.payout_timing: First deposit Sept 1-30, 2026 with code STACK; 14-day funding window to reach your tier; balance held continuously 90 days; bonus credited after the maintenance period. Top APY ~4.15% guaranteed 90 days for new users, then variable (~3.97%).
catches: Minimum $10,000 deposit to qualify for ANY bonus tier; deposits under $10,000 still earn the APY but get $0 bonus.
The qualifying balance must be maintained continuously at or above your tier minimum for the full 90-day maintenance period — if it dips, you are placed in the tier of the lowest balance maintained.
Promo code STACK must be entered at sign-up between September 1 and September 30, 2026; Raisin cannot apply it retroactively, and the offer ends 9/30/2026.

Only funds deposited within 14 days of the initial deposit count toward your tier; the savings+CD boost requires at least $1,000 in a second product category within 14 days, maintained in both categories through day 90.
APYs are variable and can change (the NexBank 4.15% rate is guaranteed only for 90 days for new users, then drops to the standard rate, currently 3.97%); interest is not a fixed payout.
The bonus and interest are both taxable and reported on a 1099-INT.

Raisin is not a bank — it is a marketplace; deposits sit at partner banks, and you are responsible for monitoring FDIC coverage per bank across all your holdings there. Deposits/withdrawals only via ACH to one linked external account.

steps.text: Go to raisin.com and register a new account, entering promo code STACK at sign-up (do this between September 1 and September 30, 2026 — it cannot be added retroactively).
Link your external bank account (one linked account; ACH only) and make your first deposit.
For the extra savings+CD boost ($10-$100 by tier, up to $1,000 total), put at least $1,000 into a second product category (e.g., a CD) within the same 14-day window.
Keep your qualifying balance continuously at or above your tier minimum for the full 90 days — any dip drops you to a lower tier.
Earn the platform APY meanwhile (top rates ~4.15-4.17%, variable); expect the bonus after the 90-day maintenance period completes.
Report the bonus and interest as taxable income (1099-INT).

routes.method: Open CD through Raisin marketplace for bonus
routes.what: Open CD through Raisin, deposit qualifying amount, earn bonus
routes.reward: 'Best CD Rates up to 4.48% APY* | Earn Up To $1,000' — *APY accurate as of September 22, 2026. Per Raisin's official September 2026 bonus terms: first deposit initiated September 1-30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET; funds deposited within 14 days of the initial deposit and maintained with partner banks for 90 days are eligible; 'Bonus payouts will be credited directly to the Referrer's and Referee's Cash Accounts within 30 days of satisfying all requirements.' CD boost: $10,000-$24,999 earns an additional $10; $25,000-$49,999 +$25; $50,000-$99,999 +$50; $100,000-$199,999 +$75; $200,000+ +$100.
routes.requirements: Varies by app: 18+, US resident, smartphone or computer, email account
routes.payout_timing: Bonus credited to the Raisin Cash Account within 30 days of satisfying all requirements. Qualifying deposits must be initiated September 1-30, 2026 and maintained with partner banks for 90 days from the initial deposit date.
catches: Bonus window ends September 30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET — the offer may disappear after that date.
Qualifying funds must be deposited within 14 days of the initial deposit and maintained for 90 days; if the balance dips, you drop to the tier matching the lowest balance maintained.
CDs lock your money for the term — early withdrawal penalties apply per the partner bank's terms.
Raisin is not an FDIC-insured bank itself; insurance covers only failure of the insured partner bank, and Raisin holds no customer funds (custodial model).
Interest rate and APY may change after initial deposit depending on the specific product selected.

steps.text: Go to https://www.raisin.com/en-us/cd-accounts/ and register a new Raisin account between September 1 and September 30, 2026 (use the applicable promo code, e.g. STACK).
Complete identity verification.
Make your first deposit within the window and fund at least $10,000 into a CD within 14 days of the initial deposit to reach a bonus tier.
For the Savings + CD Boost, put at least $1,000 into a second product category (a CD category) within 14 days and keep balances over $1,000 in both categories through day 90.
Maintain all qualifying balances continuously for 90 days from the initial deposit date.
The bonus (Welcome Bonus plus any CD boost, up to $1,000) is credited to your Raisin Cash Account within 30 days of satisfying all requirements.

routes.what: Create Tasker profile, offer online tasks, complete work
routes.reward: Taskrabbit (official support): 'the Trust & Support fee doesn't affect what a Tasker is paid. All expenses and tips go directly to your Tasker.' The Service Fee 'is calculated as a percentage of the hourly rate for your task' and is charged to the client on top of the Tasker's set rate.
routes.requirements: Varies by app: 18+, US resident, smartphone or computer, email account
routes.payout_timing: Paid via direct bank deposit after you submit an invoice through the app; typically a few business days after task completion.
catches: Zero guaranteed jobs: task volume varies by market, category, and season; reviews and ratings decide who gets booked.

Taskers keep 100% of their set hourly rate plus 100% of expenses and tips, but clients pay the Taskrabbit Service Fee and Trust & Support fee on top of your rate — higher platform fees make your quote look more expensive than it is (exact fee percentages are not published on the official support pages).
Taskers are independent contractors: no benefits, no guaranteed minimum, and you're responsible for your own taxes.
You must submit an invoice through the app after each task and wait for payment processing via direct bank deposit (a few business days); there is no instant cash-out to hand.
Remote/online task categories are competitive and often price-driven — beginners report $20-$40/hour typical ranges, not a promise.
Registration requires an application, ID/background verification, and in-app onboarding before you can accept tasks.
Cancellations, no-shows, and bad reviews directly cut future bookings.

steps.text: Download the Taskrabbit Tasker app and create a tasker account, selecting categories you can actually do — for online work, virtual assistance, data entry, or writing/editing.
Complete ID and background verification and finish onboarding before you can accept tasks.
Set your own hourly rate and availability/schedule; research what other Taskers charge in your category so you price competitively without racing to the bottom.
Accept task invitations, complete the work, and submit your invoice through the app immediately after finishing.
Link your checking account for direct deposit; payment arrives within a few business days after the invoice is processed.
Collect 5-star reviews on every job — ratings are what drive future bookings since nothing is guaranteed.
Expenses are reimbursed at 100% and tips go entirely to you, so document any out-of-pocket costs in the app.

routes.method: Complete academic research studies for universities
routes.what: Sign up, complete profile, participate in studies
routes.reward: At least $8/hr — researchers must pay a minimum of £6/$8 per hour
routes.requirements: 18+, US resident (varies), honest profile, PayPal account, quiet room for tests, smartphone or computer
routes.payout_timing: Paid after researcher approves; cash out from $6/£6 via PayPal
catches: New signups currently join a waitlist — you are invited only when tasks are available.
Study flow depends on researcher demand matching your demographics; earnings are not steady.
Researchers can reject submissions, which means no pay for that study.
Some studies may effectively underpay if they take longer than the researcher's estimate (Prolific polices this via median-time recalculation).

steps.text: Go to https://www.prolific.com/participants and click Sign up to join the waitlist (about 3 minutes: email, password, basic info).
Watch for the invite email and accept it when tasks become available for your profile.
Verify your identity with a photo ID (about 15 minutes) and complete the short practice task.
Fill out the 'About you' profile questions — these decide which studies you are offered.
Open your Studies dashboard, pick a study, and check its stated reward and estimated time before starting.
Complete the study in one sitting, following the instructions, then submit your responses.
Once the researcher approves and your balance reaches $6/£6, cash out from your Prolific account to PayPal.

routes.method: Test websites and apps by completing recorded tasks
routes.what: Apply, pass practice test, take tests
routes.reward: $10 per 15-20 min test; $4 short tests; $30-$120 live interviews
routes.requirements: 18+, US resident (varies), honest profile, PayPal account, quiet room for tests, smartphone or computer
routes.payout_timing: PayPal, usually 14 days after the test; no minimum
catches: Test availability is inconsistent and demographic-gated — most contributors get only a few tests per week.
The practice test is unpaid and your first real test is manually reviewed before you can take more.
You must wait about 14 days after each test for the PayPal payment.
Payments can be cancelled if the customer is dissatisfied and the quality review upholds it.
UserTesting does not withhold taxes — you are responsible for reporting the income.

steps.text: Go to https://usertesting.com/be-a-user-tester and enter your email address to start the application.
Complete the applicant checklist: take the short practice test (unpaid) — on a computer no download is needed; on a phone, download the UserTesting app from the App Store or Google Play first.
Create your account with your name, username, password, and zip code, and link a verified PayPal account.
Wait for your first test to be manually reviewed and scored — only then can you take more tests.
Check your dashboard for available tests; every listing shows the exact amount you will be paid before you accept.
Complete the test: follow the tasks, speak your thoughts aloud clearly, and upload the recording.
Your payment is sent to PayPal, usually 14 days after you complete the test — track it under Test history.

routes.payout_timing: Varies by utility program: instant point-of-sale discounts, or mail-in/online rebates typically paid 4-8 weeks after purchase and installation.
catches: This is a directory of thousands of separate programs, not one $1,000 offer — what you can get depends entirely on your utility and state.
Every rebate requires spending money on equipment or upgrades first; it is a discount, not cash earned.
Rebate amounts and qualifying product lists change yearly; always confirm the current program terms before buying.
Some utility rebates require pre-approval BEFORE purchase — buying first can disqualify you.

steps.text: Go to https://dsireusa.org and enter your 5-digit zip code to list incentive programs in your area.
Filter for residential rebate programs from your electric/gas utility and open the utility's program page for current amounts and terms.
Check whether the rebate needs pre-approval before purchase — if so, apply first.
Buy and install the qualifying efficient equipment within the program window and keep receipts.
Submit the utility's rebate application (online or mail-in) with proof of purchase; rebate arrives as a bill credit or check, typically in 4-8 weeks.

routes.requirements: US resident, may need to be utility customer, proof of purchase required, processing time varies
routes.payout_timing: State and utility EV-charger incentive timing varies by program. The federal 30C credit expired for property placed in service after June 30, 2026 (claims for pre-deadline installs go on the 2026 tax return).
catches: The federal EV charger tax credit (30%, up to $1,000) EXPIRED June 30, 2026 — do not promise it for new installations.
What remains are state and utility rebates that vary by location; many areas have nothing.
Every incentive requires buying and installing a charger ($500-$2,000+) first — a discount on spending, not money earned.
AFDC's own disclaimer: verify each incentive is still applicable before acting.

steps.text: Go to https://afdc.energy.gov/laws and search incentives for your state, filtering for electric-vehicle charging infrastructure.
Open each listed program and confirm it is currently funded and accepting applications — do not rely on the AFDC summary alone.
Also check your electric utility's website for charger rebates not listed federally.
Buy and install a qualifying Level 2 charger per the program's rules (some require pre-approval or a licensed electrician).
Submit the rebate application or claim the tax treatment per the program's instructions; keep all receipts and installation dates.

routes.method: Search for smart thermostat rebates from local utility
routes.what: Search local utility, purchase qualifying thermostat, apply for rebate
routes.reward: PSE: 'Qualifying line voltage connected thermostats — $75 rebate.' Norwich PUC FY27 form: 'Get up to $125 back from Norwich Public Utilities when you purchase an eligible Wi-Fi enabled smart thermostat. This rebate is good for purchases made between July 1, 2026 – June 30, 2027.'
routes.requirements: US resident, may need to be utility customer, proof of purchase required, processing time varies
routes.payout_timing: File within 60 days of purchase (PSE) or 120 days of installation (Naperville); credit/check issued roughly 4-8 weeks after a verified application. Norwich PUC FY27: requests must be received by July 15, 2027.
catches: You must buy the thermostat first and pay full price — the rebate only offsets part of the cost, and on every 2026 program found the rebate cannot exceed what you paid (PSE, SWEPCO, Cleco).
The model must be on the utility's qualifying list — typically a Wi-Fi smart thermostat, often ENERGY STAR certified; a generic programmable thermostat does not qualify.

Purchase-window rules are strict: PSE requires purchase, installation, and connection between now and 12/31/2026; Norwich PUC FY27 covers purchases July 1, 2026 – June 30, 2027; applications must be filed within the window (PSE: 60 days of purchase; Naperville: within 120 days of installation; SWEPCO: 30 days of install).
Per-account caps apply (Norwich PUC: 2 rebates; Naperville: 2 per household; Cleco: first unit $75, second $25).
Payout form varies: most pay as a utility-bill credit, but SWEPCO issues a prepaid Visa gift card that must be activated within 7 months and spent within 4 months of activation.
Rebates are funded and can be withdrawn when funding is exhausted (Naperville: 'offered until all funding is allocated').
Demand-response enrollment bonuses (e.g., Rush Hour Rewards bill credits) are separate programs from purchase rebates — do not stack them in your math unless your utility offers both.

steps.text: Go to the ENERGY STAR rebate finder at https://www.energystar.gov/rebate-finder?zip_code_filter=27949&x=12&y=16&page_number=0 and enter your ZIP code (use the finder itself, not the example ZIP) to see smart-thermostat rebates from your utility.

Open your utility's rebate page from the finder results and confirm three things: the qualifying-model list, the purchase window (e.g., PSE: purchase/install/connect by 12/31/2026), and the filing deadline (e.g., 60 days from purchase for PSE, 120 days from installation for Naperville).
Purchase a qualifying Wi-Fi smart thermostat (check it is ENERGY STAR certified / on the qualified list) inside the window and keep the dated, paid receipt showing the model number.
Install the thermostat and register/connect it via Wi-Fi with the manufacturer, if the program requires connection (PSE does).
Submit the rebate application through the utility's portal or form with your account number, the receipt, and model number — inside the filing deadline.
Receive the rebate as a bill credit, check, or prepaid gift card; if it arrives as a gift card (e.g., SWEPCO), activate it within the stated window.

routes.requirements: US resident, may need to be utility customer, proof of purchase required, processing time varies

Remaining rebates are state/utility-specific and vary from a few hundred to several thousand dollars; there is no national $2,000 offer anymore.
You must purchase a $5,000-$15,000+ system first — this is a discount on spending, not money earned.
Most programs require a participating contractor; DIY or non-listed equipment does not qualify.

steps.text: Look up heat-pump rebates for your zip code at https://dsireusa.org and on your electric/gas utility's website — amounts and rules are local.
Confirm the current program is funded and accepting applications (e.g., NYS Clean Heat runs through 2030; check your own state's status).
Get quotes only from contractors participating in your local rebate program and confirm the equipment model is on the program's qualifying list.
Install the qualifying heat-pump system; the rebate is applied at point of sale or paid through the contractor after installation.
Do NOT claim the federal 25C credit for any system placed in service after December 31, 2025 — it no longer exists.

routes.reward: Find rebates and special offers near you on ENERGY STAR certified products. (Federal 25C cooling-equipment credit: expired for property placed in service after December 31, 2025.)
routes.requirements: US resident, may need to be utility customer, proof of purchase required, processing time varies
routes.payout_timing: Utility rebates are typically paid 4-8 weeks after the cooling equipment is installed and documented. The federal 25C credit is closed for 2026 installations.
catches: The federal tax credit for efficient cooling equipment (25C) EXPIRED December 31, 2025.
Remaining rebates are utility-specific and vary by location; amounts are typically $25-$300, not $500.
You must buy the equipment first — this is a discount on spending, not money earned.
Some programs require pre-approval before purchase.

steps.text: Look up cooling rebates for your zip code at https://www.energystar.gov/rebate-finder and https://dsireusa.org.
Open your utility's specific offer and confirm it is live, the qualifying equipment specs, and any pre-approval requirement.
Buy and install the qualifying cooling equipment or smart thermostat and keep receipts.
Submit the rebate application with proof of purchase; the rebate arrives as a bill credit or check, typically in 4-8 weeks.

routes.method: Search for LED lighting rebates from local utility
routes.what: Search local utility, purchase qualifying LED fixtures, apply for rebate
routes.reward: Glencoe Light & Power 2026 Residential LED Lighting Rebate: 'Rebated bulbs are the lesser of $3 or the cost of the bulb; rebated fixtures are the lesser of $10 or cost of the fixture; rebated linear tubes are the lesser of $4 or the cost of the tube... the total rebate limit is $350 per year per customer account.'
routes.requirements: US resident, may need to be utility customer, proof of purchase required, processing time varies
routes.payout_timing: Typically 4-8 weeks after a complete application (Glencoe 2026: '6 to 8 weeks for processing'). Hard application deadlines apply per program (Glencoe: apply by November 30, 2026).
catches: Residential LED rebates have shrunk: Glencoe Light & Power 2026 pays the lesser of $3 per bulb, $10 per fixture, $4 per linear tube, capped at $350/year per account — real but small.

The big per-fixture numbers ($50-$150+ indoor troffers/high bays, $100-$300+ outdoor, per industry guides; UI 2026: $40-$230 per exterior/custom fixture) are commercial programs — residential customers do not qualify.
Product-listing rules: ENERGY STAR no longer certifies LED fixtures (Austin Utilities 2026 form requires DesignLights Consortium certification for fixtures instead); buying an unlisted fixture = $0.
Commercial programs almost always require pre-approval before purchase; installing without it can disqualify the project.
2026 deadlines are hard: Glencoe requires applications by November 30, 2026 ('Incomplete rebate applications will not be processed').
Rebates never exceed equipment cost ('the lesser of $3 or the cost of the bulb' — Glencoe; rebate capped at 50% of cost at several utilities).
Funding is capped and first-come: 'Annual rebate funds are limited. Rebate programs, qualifications, and amounts are subject to change at any time' (Glencoe 2026).

steps.text: Go to the ENERGY STAR rebate finder at https://www.energystar.gov/rebate-finder?zip_code_filter=27949&x=12&y=16&page_number=0 and enter your ZIP code to find your utility's current lighting rebates (look under the Lighting & Fans category).

Open your utility's 2026 rebate form and confirm: which products qualify (note whether fixtures require DLC listing — ENERGY STAR no longer certifies LED fixtures), the per-item amounts, whether you need pre-approval, and the application deadline.
If it is a commercial program, get pre-approval before purchasing — installing without it can disqualify the project.
Purchase qualifying LED bulbs/fixtures within the program window; keep the dated receipt and the packaging showing the ENERGY STAR or DLC logo, manufacturer, and model number.
Submit the rebate application with the receipt and product details before the deadline (e.g., Glencoe: by November 30, 2026; within one year of purchase).
Receive the rebate check or bill credit — typically in 4-8 weeks (Glencoe: 6-8 weeks).

routes.method: Search state energy office for additional incentives
routes.what: Search state energy office website, apply for available programs
routes.reward: N.C. Clean Energy Technology Center: DSIRE 'includes summaries of more than 2,600 incentives and policies' and 'is used by over 180,000 different people each month.' DSIRE April 2026 summary: 'Incentives for Solar Photovoltaics are available in 45 states + DC.'
routes.requirements: US resident, may need to be utility customer, proof of purchase required, processing time varies
routes.payout_timing: Varies by program — each state/utility program sets its own application windows and processing times; always confirm the deadline on the program's official page.
catches: DSIRE entries can go stale: the solarenergyworld.com 2026 guide warns 'Always verify the last update date... If a page appears outdated, follow the website link provided for the most recent details.'
Programs are funding-limited and first-come; several state programs were paused in 2025 during federal funding freezes and may not have resumed.

NASEO's site represents the 56 state/territory energy offices and their directors — it is an association resource, not a rebate application portal; you still apply through the individual state office.
The catalog's own examples need care: federal IRA-era rebate programs (HOMES/HEEHRA) are state-administered and were never universal; treat legacy mentions skeptically.

DOE's FY2026 enacted budget keeps the Weatherization Assistance Program ($9.6M) and State Energy Program ($4.5M) funded — these flow through state energy offices but are grants to states, not direct consumer checks.
The route overlaps R0315/R0321 in method (look up your utility); its unique value is catching state-level programs utilities don't list.

steps.text: Open the DSIRE database via the N.C. Clean Energy Technology Center page at https://nccleantech.ncsu.edu/renewable-energy-resources/dsire/ (or find your state energy office through the NASEO member network at https://naseo.org).
Select your state (or enter your ZIP code) and filter for the incentive type you want — rebates, tax credits, loan programs, weatherization.
Read each listing's summary AND its last-update date; skip anything that looks stale or whose funding status is unclear.

Click through to the official program page (state energy office or utility) and verify the current terms, eligibility, funding status, and application deadline — do not apply based on the DSIRE summary alone.
Apply through the program's own official application before its deadline, keeping receipts and documentation as that program requires.

routes.method: Apply for federal energy assistance if eligible
routes.what: Apply through state LIHEAP office with income documentation
routes.reward: Heating Assistance was provided by 51 states and served 5,028,871 households with estimated average benefits of $380. Cooling Assistance was provided by 23 states and served 751,119 households with estimated average benefits of $583.
routes.requirements: US resident, may need to be utility customer, proof of purchase required, processing time varies
routes.payout_timing: Each state runs seasonal application windows; once approved, the benefit is paid directly to the household's energy vendor, typically within weeks. Crisis assistance for shutoff emergencies is expedited.
catches: You never receive cash — LIHEAP pays your energy company directly. It is bill assistance, not income.
The national average heating benefit is about $380, far below the route's $1,000 top end.
Income-restricted: at or below 150% of the poverty line (or 60% of state median income).
Funding is limited — only a fraction of eligible households are served each year.
Applications are only open during each state's seasonal window; miss it and you wait a year.

steps.text: Confirm your household income is at or below 150% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines (or 60% of your state's median income).

Find your state's LIHEAP office and its current application window via the ACF LIHEAP guidance hub at https://acf.gov/ocs/policy-guidance/liheap-im2026-01-federal-poverty-guidelines-fpg-and-state-median-income-smi (follow links to state contacts).
Apply during the open window with income documentation, ID, and a recent energy bill.
If approved, the benefit is credited to your energy account by the vendor — no check comes to you.
If facing a shutoff, ask about crisis assistance, which is processed faster.

routes.method: Apply for free home weatherization if income-eligible
routes.what: Apply through state weatherization office with income documentation
routes.reward: Through weatherization improvements and upgrades, these households save on average $372 or more every year according to a national evaluation of the program.
routes.requirements: US resident, may need to be utility customer, proof of purchase required, processing time varies
routes.payout_timing: No fixed payout — free weatherization services are scheduled after application approval; state-agency waitlists of several months are typical; savings accrue as lower energy bills.
catches: This pays $0 in cash — you receive free home improvements and lower bills, not money. It is savings, not income.
Income-restricted: at or below 200% of the federal poverty line. An average user above that line gets nothing.
State-administered with limited slots (~32,000 homes/year nationally per DOE) — waitlists of months are normal.
Renters need written landlord permission before any work.
DOE publishes no per-home dollar figure; the route's '$1,000-$10,000+' describes the value of free services, not a payment.

steps.text: Confirm your household income is at or below 200% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines (check the current HHS poverty guidelines table).
Go to the official DOE page https://energy.gov/wap and open the 'how to apply' page to find your state's WAP administrator.
Contact your state's WAP office or local community action agency and complete the application with income documentation.
A certified auditor performs a home energy audit to determine the most cost-effective improvements.
Approved improvements (insulation, air sealing, HVAC, etc.) are installed at no cost to you by the agency's contractors.

The Playtester Onboarding (qualification test) is unpaid.
You must pass the onboarding review to join the tester panel and start receiving paid playtests.

steps.text: Sign up at https://www.playtestcloud.com/ (become a playtester) — free.
Complete the short, unpaid Playtester Onboarding test to prove your commentary quality and device capability.

Payout timing: 'earnings are available for withdrawal after a safety clearance period of 14 days after the order is marked as complete, while Top Rated Sellers are eligible after 7 days.'

routes.payout_timing: Earnings become available for withdrawal 14 days after an order is marked complete (7 days for Top Rated Sellers). Withdrawals: 1-3 business days via PayPal, 3-5+ via bank transfer/Payoneer.
catches: Zero guaranteed jobs or income: you set gig prices, but buyers must choose you; competition is intense and new sellers get little visibility.
Fiverr takes a flat 20% commission on every order, including tips — a $100 order credits you $80.
Earnings are locked for a 14-day safety clearance period after order completion (7 days only for Top Rated Sellers) before they become available for withdrawal.

Withdrawal methods carry their own fees/processing times: PayPal, bank transfer via Payoneer, Payoneer account, and Fiverr Revenue Card (new Revenue Cards can no longer be created; existing users may keep theirs).

Buyers also pay a 5.5% service fee plus a $3.50 small-order fee on orders under $200 (per Fiverr's Payment Terms, last updated January 2026), which inflates your gig's real price and pushes buyers toward cheaper sellers.
Orders can be cancelled or disputed by buyers; funds are held until disputes resolve. Low starting prices mean very low effective hourly rates.
Identity verification may be required before withdrawing; Fiverr pays in USD, so currency conversion fees may apply.

steps.text: Create a free Fiverr seller account at fiverr.com and complete your profile (skills, portfolio, photo).
Create gigs describing exactly what you'll deliver, with a starting price you set yourself — remember Fiverr keeps 20%, so a $50 gig pays you $40.
Win orders by responding fast and delivering quality work; buyers must accept the delivery (or it auto-completes) for earnings to post.
Wait out the 14-day clearance period after each completed order (7 days once you reach Top Rated Seller status).
Go to Selling > Earnings, verify your identity if asked, and link a withdrawal method (PayPal, bank transfer via Payoneer, or Payoneer account).
Withdraw cleared earnings (minimums and per-method fees apply); expect 1-3 business days for PayPal, 3-7 for bank transfer.
Reinvest in reviews and gig quality — without orders there is no payout, so treat the first gigs as reputation-building.

routes.method: Bet on your weight loss goal
routes.what: Set weight loss goal, place bet, lose weight, win money
routes.reward: NO fixed $500: prize is algorithm-calculated from your goal, bet, timeframe, BMI (official page shows real winner prizes $1,163-$10,984). You bet YOUR OWN money (one-time or monthly); prize paid only after verified video weigh-ins + referee certification. Absolutely NO refunds or cancellations — miss the goal, lose the wager
routes.requirements: Varies by app: 18+, US resident, smartphone or computer, email account
routes.payout_timing: Prize paid after verified final weigh-in and referee certification (within 7 days); no fixed $500 amount — prize is algorithm-calculated.
catches: No fixed $500 payout exists on official pages — prizes are algorithm-calculated (based on your goal, bet, timeframe, BMI); the official page shows real winner prizes ranging from $1,163 to $10,984.
You fund the wager yourself: pay in full up front or in monthly installments. Official FAQ: 'you can't quit — there are absolutely no cancellations or refunds.'
Both start and end weights require a verified video weigh-in via the app (smartphone + scale), and winners submit photo ID for identity/height confirmation.
A referee team reviews your win and certifies it within 7 days; you must maintain your weight loss through that review window.
Minimum goal is typically 10% of body weight (per official calculator flow and challenge rules) — this is a serious weight-loss commitment, not a side gig.

Health risk: rapid/unhealthy weight loss is a real danger. Get doctor clearance before attempting; pregnancy pauses your challenge; weight loss via bariatric surgery or other surgical intervention disqualifies you; weight-loss medications (incl. GLP-1s) require doctor care.
Winnings above the IRS $600 threshold are reported for taxes; HealthyWage does not withhold.
Yo-yo rule: if you previously won $200+, future challenges must start at or below your last ending weight — you cannot re-bet the same weight loss repeatedly.

steps.text: Open the official HealthyWager page and use the prize calculator to see your algorithm-calculated prize for your goal weight, bet amount, and timeframe — there is no fixed $500; your prize is personalized.
Choose your goal (typically at least 10% of your body weight) and your wager amount; decide to pay the full amount up front or in monthly installments.
Download the HealthyWage app and complete your verified starting weigh-in: step on your scale and follow the on-screen instructions to record the short weigh-in video.
Work toward your goal within your challenge timeframe — there are no monthly milestones; only the final result matters.
In the final two weeks of your challenge (no earlier), complete your verified ending weigh-in via the app.
Submit the winner confirmation form with photo ID so HealthyWage can verify your identity and height.
Maintain your weight loss while the referee team reviews and certifies your win (within 7 days).
Receive your prize after certification — report it for taxes if above the IRS $600 threshold.

routes.what: Sign up, apply to campaigns, create content
routes.reward: Typically pricing begins at $250 per asset (brand-set; pay may be PRODUCT-ONLY); paid by client no earlier than 30 days after campaign end; creator bears 2.9% PayPal fees; Cohley disclaims liability if client doesn't pay
routes.requirements: 18+, US resident (varies), smartphone with good camera, comfortable filming product videos, no following required for most UGC campaigns
routes.payout_timing: Paid by the client per the creative brief, no earlier than 30 days after the campaign end date.
catches: The 'Typically pricing begins at $250 per asset' figure is brand-facing budget guidance, not a creator pay guarantee — actual compensation is set per creative brief by the client and can also be free product only.
Creators are paid by the CLIENT, not by Cohley: 'Creator shall be paid by Client in accordance with the Creative Brief' — Cohley explicitly disclaims liability if a client fails to pay.
Payment arrives no earlier than 30 days after the campaign end date — slow compared to other platforms.
The creator bears all PayPal fees (2.9% of total compensation) plus taxes; fail to set up PayPal within 30 days of campaign end and you forfeit all compensation.
Pre-vetted creator network: you need an existing portfolio and to pass vetting — not open to beginners.
Content ownership/license terms are in the brand's favor per the creator terms (review the Ownership section before signing).
Variable gig work, NOT fixed income: zero guaranteed campaigns, brands select which creators they accept, and content-rights terms vary per brief.

steps.text: Create your free Cohley creator account and complete your profile with a name, email, country of residence, profile photo, and portfolio work samples (portfolio is required — vetting is not automatic).
Review and accept Cohley's Creator Terms & Conditions — note you are paid by the client, not Cohley, and you bear PayPal fees.
Get matched to brand briefs (AI-matched by niche and demographics); each brief states its compensation — confirm it is cash, not product-only, before accepting.
Deliver the assets per the brief (typical 21-34 second 9:16 video, ~1 week turnaround).
Set up your PayPal account within 30 days of the campaign end date or you forfeit compensation.
Receive payment per the creative brief, no earlier than 30 days after the campaign end date, minus 2.9% PayPal fees.

routes.what: Create Upwork profile, bid on projects, complete work
routes.reward: Upwork (official): 'Upwork charges freelancers a variable 0%-15% service fee per contract.' Funds are released through escrow: fixed-price milestones release on client approval (or automatically after 14 days of client inaction); hourly invoices are held through a 4-day client dispute review and released on the Friday after the work week.
routes.requirements: Varies by app: 18+, US resident, smartphone or computer, email account
routes.payout_timing: Fixed-price: funds released on client approval, or automatically 14 days after a release request if the client is inactive. Hourly: weekly cycle — invoice generated Monday, client review through Thursday, funds released Friday. Withdrawal 1-3 business days via ACH.
catches: Zero guaranteed jobs or income: you bid against global competition; most proposals win nothing, and Connects ($0.15 each, typically 6-16 per proposal) are spent win or lose.

Freelancer service fee is variable 0%-15% per contract for contracts formed on or after May 2025, fixed for the contract and disclosed at proposal time — you cannot know your exact fee until you see a specific contract. Pre-May-2025 contracts keep a flat 10% fee.
Clients also pay their own marketplace fee (5%, or 3% via eligible ACH; 10%/8% on Business Plus) plus a $0.99-$14.99 contract initiation fee — this shrinks client budgets and your effective rate.
Withdrawal fees: ACH, PayPal, and Payoneer withdrawals are free; wire transfer costs $50; Instant Pay (US) costs $2 per transfer.

Fixed-price funds sit in escrow: released on client approval or auto-released after 14 days of client inaction. Hourly contracts run a weekly cycle with a 4-day client dispute review before funds release on Friday.
Payment can be held or pending for identity verification, unverified client payment methods, or suspected account issues. Upwork does not guarantee a client will pay beyond escrowed funds.
Optional Freelancer Plus is $19.99/month. Disputes go through Upwork mediation and can end in arbitration. Low-ball bidding drives very low effective hourly rates for beginners.

steps.text: Create a free Upwork freelancer profile with a real photo, skill tags, portfolio samples, and a rate — identity verification will be required before you can withdraw.
Buy Connects ($0.15 each) and spend them to submit proposals (typically 6-16 Connects per job); the exact service fee (0%-15%) is shown on each contract before you bid.
Win a contract and agree terms in writing; for fixed-price work the client funds escrow up front — never start before escrow is funded.
Do the work: for hourly contracts log time in Upwork's tracker (Work Diary); for fixed-price, submit milestones for client approval.
Wait for funds to clear escrow — client approval, or 14-day auto-release on fixed-price; Friday release for hourly after the 4-day dispute review.
Withdraw free via ACH/PayPal/Payoneer (1-3 business days) once your balance clears; avoid the $50 wire and $2 Instant Pay fees.
Build reviews and repeat clients — your effective rate rises as you stop competing on price for entry-level jobs.

routes.what: Create narrator profile, audition for audiobook projects, narrate
routes.reward: Royalty Share: equal share of 20% (legacy) / 25% (new) of audiobook royalties from Audible/Amazon/Apple sales; Pay-for-Production: one-time per-finished-hour fee agreed with rights holder; monthly electronic payments; sub-$50 royalties carried forward. Royalty share pays $0 unless the book SELLS
routes.requirements: 18+, US resident, quiet recording space, microphone, good speaking voice, computer
routes.payout_timing: PFH paid on delivery/approval per the rights-holder agreement; royalty-share payments monthly via electronic payment from Audible (amounts under $50 carried forward).
catches: Per-finished-hour rate is agreed with each rights holder; ACX publishes no minimum PFH rate, so the official terms do not fix your pay.
Royalty Share (20% legacy / 25% new of royalties) pays nothing unless the title sells; customer returns within 7 days reduce net sales units.
Royalties below $50 in an accounting period are carried forward by Audible, not paid out.
You must deliver ACX-spec audio and pass quality review (review within 10 business days); rework costs you time, and rights holders may request two full rounds of changes.
Royalty Share distribution runs for the term of the Book Posting Agreement (exclusive); the voice-replica model pays a smaller share (10% legacy / 12.5% new) over a 7-year distribution period.
Editing/mastering costs (your time or a hired engineer) come out of whatever you earn.
Variable gig work, NOT fixed income: zero guaranteed bookings; you audition against a large talent pool and brands pick who they want.

steps.text: Go to the official ACX site and create a producer (narrator) profile.
Browse posted projects and audition for titles that fit your voice.

When a rights holder offers you the project, agree on terms: a per-finished-hour fee (Pay-for-Production), a royalty share (20% legacy / 25% new of audiobook royalties), or Royalty Share Plus (reduced upfront PFH + royalty split).
Record and master the audiobook to ACX audio specifications; the rights holder may request up to two full rounds of changes.
After rights-holder approval and ACX quality review (within 10 business days), get paid per your agreement — upfront for PFH, monthly via electronic payment from Audible for royalty share.
